absent: Numeric values and widths for pin bias, intent and mapping flags, huge page sizes and masks, section size, and error markers.
Memory layouts for folio, page, address space, area, mapping, reservation, and table entry structures.

Definitions and contracts of unrouted helpers such as reference and pin adjusters, folio lookup and state testers, sanity validation, fault handling, splitting, allocation, accessibility, and cache update helpers.
Lock ordering, sleepability, interrupt, and concurrency rules beyond the locally visible lock takes and releases.
Selection predicates and structures for shareable versus private hugetlb locks and reservation maps.
Long term pinnability, per node accounting, anonymous exclusivity transitions, and merged page handling details.
Userfault, soft dirty platform support, and protection none policy beyond the gated checks shown.
Slow path pin and get entry points, dump page handling, and device memory rules beyond the fast path exclusion.

findings.text: Provides a pin-adding operation for a folio that leaves the shared zero folio untouched and otherwise records one pin using either a dedicated exact count plus a normal reference or a large bias on the normal count, with debug checks that prior counts already look pinned.

Releases pins for a page pointer array by grouping consecutive entries owned by the same folio and releasing each group once, advancing by one over null slots and warning then returning early when the count looks like an encoded error.

Releases pins for a page array with an optional dirty request; without that request it delegates to plain unpin, otherwise it validates the input and for each folio group marks the folio dirty under lock when observed clean before releasing the group pins.

Releases pins for a contiguous run described by a start page and length, asserting contiguity in debug builds, optionally marking each involved folio dirty under lock when observed clean, then releasing each folio group once.
Releases a caller supplied number of pins from one folio in a single call.

Releases pins for a folio array by coalescing runs of equal folio pointers and releasing each run once, skipping null entries and warning then returning early when the count looks like an encoded error.

Reports whether a page range is physically contiguous by comparing frame numbers across memory section boundaries, treating the first section as implicitly contiguous and verifying the reachable start of each further spanned section.
Reports whether the file page cache currently holds a folio for an address in a hugetlb area by translating the address to an index and attempting a cache lookup, releasing the reference on success.

Updates access tracking for a huge middle level entry by marking it young and additionally dirty for writes, installing the updated entry and refreshing cached translation state when the hardware update reports a change.

Provides paired walk brackets that acquire and release read side protection only for hugetlb areas, selecting between a shareable area lock and a private reservation lock consistently for take and release.

Slow path resolver for an address in an area that brackets the walk with hugetlb protection, clears the huge page mask, treats a missing or malformed top entry as an absent table, and otherwise descends through lower levels.
Non sleeping fast attempt that records references or pins for a page and returns its folio on success or failure so the caller can fall back to the slow path, expecting interrupt disabled context.

Two helpers compute the size of a same folio group, one for a contiguous run using large folio size and offset capped by remaining length, the other for a pointer list by scanning forward until the owning folio changes.

Pin accounting always keeps at least one normal reference while pinned, prefers an exact dedicated count when supported and otherwise uses a large bias on the normal count, and never establishes a pin on the shared zero page or folio.

Fast acquisition requires get or pin intent, excludes peer device memory unless peer intent is present, returns the zero page folio without pinning, enforces long term pinnability for long term intent with release on failure, then adjusts exact or biased counts with ordering before table recheck and per node accounting.

Write following without a writable entry is allowed only under force on a private mapping that may become writable but is not currently writable, and only for an exclusive anonymous page; force has no effect on shared mappings or read only private mappings.

Each table level first accepts a hardware writable entry and otherwise defers to the common force policy, with middle and leaf levels additionally requiring no pending soft dirty write fault and no userfault write protection.

Unsharing is considered only for read only pin operations without write intent; non anonymous pages matter only for long term pins in copy on write mappings with special handling when no area is supplied, while anonymous pages require exclusivity after a read barrier, which excludes merged same content pages.

Missing tables normally yield absence, but dumping requests a fault marker to skip fault handling and leave a hole when the hole is known to read as zero, namely absent hugetlb cache entries and anonymous or fault less mappings.

Leaf resolution maps and locks the leaf table, treats absent or disallowed protection none entries as missing, resolves the normal page, enforces write policy, maps special pages to dump errors or zero page hits or pfn handling, rejects pins that must unshare, warns on suspicious pinned anonymous state, acquires a reference or pin, makes pinned folios accessible with unwind on failure, and applies dirty and accessed tracking for touch requests before unlocking on every path.

Middle descent reads entries without locks first, treats missing or non present tables as absent, follows non leaf entries down, rechecks presence and leaf status under lock, splits a transparent huge entry when split is requested with allocation fallback to leaf resolution, and otherwise delegates leaf handling to the huge middle follower.

Upper descent checks presence, takes the upper lock only for leaf entries and falls back to absent table handling when the leaf follower yields nothing, rejects malformed entries, and otherwise continues downward, with the top level asserting that its own leaf form never occurs.

Huge leaf followers require the caller to hold the corresponding table lock, reject absent entries, enforce write policy, translate the faulting address into the covered page, reject pins that must unshare, acquire a reference or pin, and report a mask covering the whole huge page, with the middle case additionally skipping the huge zero page for dumps, enforcing protection none policy, warning on suspicious anonymous pin state, and touching transparent huge entries when requested.
An alternate build provides huge leaf followers that unconditionally report absence, effectively disabling huge page following at those levels.

Soft dirty write fault need is reported only when the platform supports tracking and the area has tracking enabled by lacking the soft dirty marker, combined with a missing hardware dirty marker at the relevant level.

Entries without a normal page structure optionally refresh young and dirty tracking when touch is requested and then report a distinct exists marker so callers distinguish them from ordinary missing tables.
A helper records once per address space that pinning has occurred, setting the pinned marker only when not already present.

A fast path unpin helper releases folio groups without sanity validation because a concurrent fork may have turned previously exclusive anonymous pages into shared ones, which is the reason for unpinning.

Dirty marking during unpin observes dirtiness without locks, then takes the folio lock only around the clean to dirty transition and releases it before releasing pins, tolerating races with writeback that either still write back or cause one extra writeback.

Huge leaf followers run under the corresponding table lock held by the caller, middle descent acquires that lock to revalidate leaf state and releases it on every exit including split and fallback paths, and leaf resolution holds the mapped leaf lock from lookup through reference acquisition and tracking until unmap.
Address walks are bracketed by a read side hugetlb reservation lock only for hugetlb areas, using the shareable area lock or the private reservation lock consistently for acquisition and release.

Callers must not pass encoded errors as counts, must not assume null free arrays, must only use the range unpin form on truly contiguous runs, and must expect concurrent fork, writeback cleaning, huge page splitting, and copy on write breaking to change sharing, dirtiness, and table shape during these operations.

Dumping must avoid instantiating pages or tables and must exclude special and huge zero pages, while pinning for access must ensure device accessibility and must fail with a link marker when an exclusive anonymous page is required but sharing is observed.

Resolution proceeds from top to leaf through presence and malformed checks, leaf versus table dispatch, protection none gating, write and unshare gating, reference acquisition, optional accessibility and touch handling, with absent tables diverted to dump aware hole handling and huge leaves returning a coverage mask.

Pins move from acquisition with exact or biased counting and long term validation, through optional dirty marking under lock, to grouped release that coalesces same folio entries, with zero pages bypassing the pinned state entirely.
Intent coordination uses FOLL_GET and FOLL_PIN and FOLL_WRITE and FOLL_FORCE and FOLL_TOUCH and FOLL_DUMP and FOLL_SPLIT_PMD and FOLL_LONGTERM and FOLL_PCI_P2PDMA.

Mapping and outcome coordination uses VM_MAYSHARE and VM_SHARED and VM_MAYWRITE and VM_WRITE and VM_SOFTDIRTY and EFAULT and EMLINK and EEXIST and ENOMEM and HPAGE_PMD_NR and HPAGE_PUD_NR and PUD_MASK and HPAGE_PMD_MASK and PAGES_PER_SECTION and GUP_PIN_COUNTING_BIAS.

The fragments interact with folio and page identity, per folio reference and optional exact pin counts, area descriptors carrying flags with address space and file and operation links, and table entries exposing presence with writability and youth and dirtiness and protection none state, without revealing in fragment layout or widths.
